text:
maria: Postmortem merged for the failover/cache spike. Need concrete owners for runbook + playbook changes and a short remediation timeline. Who volunteers?

jin: I'll own the triage checklist edits. Will add explicit commands, decision gates, and the fallback criteria.

sam: I'll take automation + the smoke harness. Plan to add a CI job to run the runbook steps in staging.

ops-bot: Reminder: use runbook-change template and reference the postmortem ID in PRs: https://redwood.internal/templates/runbook-change.md :memo:

alex: Pattern we saw: failover -> cache eviction -> request pileup -> routing latency. Add triage checks for eviction rate and queue depth. Example Prom query: `curl -s "http://prom/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[1m])" | jq -r .data.result[0].value[1]`. Also check router CPU via HPA metrics.

leo: Doc style: prefer `--output=json` or `--json` flags and show `jq` parsers so automation can pick values.

maria: Proposed owners + deadlines: jin (triage + commands) by Tue EOD, sam (automation + tests) by next Thu, alex (alerts & escalation) by next Fri, leo (doc QA) by Wed. Agree?

jin: Works. I'll include `redis-cli INFO` checks and a decision table: if eviction_rate > 1000/min -> immediate fallback + page; if 400-1000 -> start warmup + scale workers; else warmup-only.

sam: Draft smoke script for infra tests: 
```
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
python tools/simulate_failover.py --env=staging || true
ab -n 300 -c 10 http://staging/health || true
curl -s "http://prom/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[1m])" | jq -r .data.result[0].value[1] > /tmp/evict_rate
python tools/check_warmup.py --threshold 0.6 --output json
```

alex: Alerts: composite alert eviction_rate > 400/min AND router_cpu > 65% for 5m -> page primary oncall. Add fallback route command: `redwoodctl route update --service=generator --variant=m-quantized-compact --weight=1.0`.

maria: Also add a runbook step to run `redis-cli INFO` and a warmup script. Jin/sam 1 can you produce a warmup plan?

jin: Proposed warmup command: `python scripts/redis_warm.py --pattern "user:*" --concurrency 20 --dry-run --output json`. Guidance: only remove `--dry-run` after verifying latency and eviction trend improvement.

sam: I'll implement `redis_warm.py` with throttling and exclude-heavy-keys option. Will add integration tests and a `runbook_smoke` CI job.

alex: Add a temporary circuit-breaker for noncritical traffic during warmup: `redwoodctl throttle set --service=search --rate=500rps` and include rollback commands.

leo: Minor: ensure docs include parsed sample output lines like `jq -r .data.result[0].value[1]` and `redis-cli INFO | grep used_memory_human` so linting can verify.

maria: Ops-bot, can you create GH tasks for these items and tag security for KMS verification?

ops-bot: Created task RW-PT-1101 assigned: jin, sam, alex, leo. Labels: postmortem-followup, runbook.

sam: I'll run a dry-run canary next Wed and post logs here.

jin: PR opened for runbook edits: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/834. Includes triage checklist, decision table, commands, and escalation steps.

sam: Scripts PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-scripts/pull/231 with `redis_warm.py`, `check_warmup.py`, and CI job.

maria: Timeline recap: runbook PR by 2026-04-08, automation merged by 2026-04-15, canary drill week of 2026-04-20. I'll set invites and a short review. After successful drill we'll close action items. :white_check_mark:
